title: CCD-Bench: Probing Cultural Conflict in Large Language Model Decision-Making
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on cross-cultural value conflicts based on the GLOBE framework across domains like family, work, and lifestyle.
findings: The paper did not report any findings specifically related to religion, as its focus was on secular cultural values and dimensions.
